faqs.question: What organization am I in?
faqs.answer: You can view your organization details in the Profile tab. Admins can manage members in the Organization tab.

faqs.question: How can I see my role?
faqs.answer: Your role is displayed on the Profile page. Roles determine if you can edit specimens or only view them.

faqs.question: How do I add a new specimen?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Add Specimen' button on the Dashboard. This is only available to Admin users.

faqs.question: How do I edit a specimen?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Edit' button next to a specimen on the Dashboard. This is only available to Admin users.

faqs.question: How do I delete a specimen?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Delete' button next to a specimen on the Dashboard. This is only available to Admin users.

faqs.question: How can I check the status of a specimen?
faqs.answer: The status of each specimen is displayed in the Status column on the Dashboard. You can also click on a specimen to view more details.

faqs.question: I need help with something else.
faqs.answer: I can navigate you to the help page! Or for further assistance, please contact your administrator or support team.
